lv_source: {"id":"a1-jung","layout":"standardStudy","translation":"jauns (par cilvēkiem)","explanation":["Galvenā doma: jung nozīmē jauns vecuma ziņā — lieto par cilvēkiem un dzīvniekiem, ne par lietām.","jung raksturo vecumu — pretstats ir alt (vecs).","Latviešu valodā vārdam jauns ir divas nozīmes: jauns vecumā (jung) un jauns/nesen radīts (neu).","Par lietām, kas nesen radītas vai iegādātas, lieto neu, ne jung.","jung lieto arī pārnestā nozīmē: jauna paaudze, jauns pāris, jauni cilvēki.","Ir arī lietvārds die Jugend (jaunatne, jaunība)."],"examples":[{"de":"Sie ist noch jung.","lv":"viņa ir vēl jauna."},{"de":"Der Hund ist jung.","lv":"suns ir jauns."},{"de":"Wir sind noch jung.","lv":"mēs esam vēl jauni."},{"de":"Er sieht sehr jung aus.","lv":"viņš izskatās ļoti jauns."},{"de":"Das ist ein junges Paar.","lv":"tas ir jauns pāris."},{"de":"Die junge Frau lächelt.","lv":"jaunā sieviete smaida."},{"de":"Mein Bruder ist jünger als ich.","lv":"mans brālis ir jaunāks nekā es."}],"tip":["jung ir par vecumu (cilvēki, dzīvnieki) — ja runā par lietām, kas nesen radītas, lieto neu.","Pretstats: jung ↔ alt (jauns ↔ vecs)."],"important":["jung raksturo vecumu, ne lietas jaunumu.","Par jaunām lietām (telefonu, automašīnu, māju) lieto neu, nevis jung.","Nepareizi: Mein Handy ist jung. → Pareizi: Mein Handy ist neu."],"sectionAccents":{"explanation":{"blue":["jung"],"purple":["jauns"],"green":["neu"]},"examples":[{"de":{"blue":["jung"]},"lv":{"purple":["jauna"]}},{"de":{"blue":["jung"]},"lv":{"purple":["jauns"]}},{"de":{"blue":["jung"]},"lv":{"purple":["jauni"]}},{"de":{"blue":["jung"]},"lv":{"purple":["jauns"]}},{"de":{"blue":["junge"]},"lv":{"purple":["jauns"]}},{"de":{"blue":["junge"]},"lv":{"purple":["jaunā"]}},{"de":{"blue":["jünger"]},"lv":{"purple":["jaunāks"]}}],"tip":[{"blue":["jung"],"green":["neu"]},{"blue":["jung"],"purple":["alt"]}],"important":[{"blue":["jung"]},{"green":["neu"],"blue":["jung"]},{"blue":["jung"],"green":["neu"]}]}}
production_current: {"id":"a1-jung","layout":"standardStudy","translation":"Mladi ljudi","explanation":["Основна идея: Юнг означава млада възраст, използвана по отношение на хора и животни, а не неща.","Юнг описва възрастта - обратното - виола (стар).","V latvijščini ima beseda mladi dva pomena: mladi v starosti (jung) in mladi/na novo ustvarjeni (neu).","За неща, наскоро създадени или придобити, използвайте neu, ne jung.","Юнг се използва и в преносен смисъл: ново поколение, млада двойка, млади хора.","Съществува и съществителното die Jugend (младеж)."],"examples":[{"de":"Sie ist noch jung.","lv":"Тя е още млада."},{"de":"Der Hund ist jung.","lv":"Pes je mlad."},{"de":"Wir sind noch jung.","lv":"Ние сме уште млади."},{"de":"Er sieht sehr jung aus.","lv":"Изглежда много млад."},{"de":"Das ist ein junges Paar.","lv":"To je nov par."},{"de":"Die junge Frau lächelt.","lv":"Усмихната млада жена."},{"de":"Mein Bruder ist jünger als ich.","lv":"Брат ми е помлад од мене."}],"tip":["Jung - o starosti (ljudje, živali) - ko govorite o stvareh, ki so bile ustvarjene v zadnjem času, uporabite neu.","Напротив: jung ↔ alt (млад ↔ стар)."],"important":["Јунг ја опишува возраста, а не новоста на нешто.","Za nove stvari (telefon, auto, kuća) koristite neu umjesto jung.","Netačno: Mein Handy ist jung. → Točno: Mein Handy ist neu."],"sectionAccents":{"explanation":{"blue":["jung"],"green":["neu"]},"examples":[{"de":{"blue":["jung"]},"lv":{}},{"de":{"blue":["jung"]},"lv":{}},{"de":{"blue":["jung"]},"lv":{}},{"de":{"blue":["jung"]},"lv":{}},{"de":{"blue":["junge"]},"lv":{}},{"de":{"blue":["junge"]},"lv":{}},{"de":{"blue":["jünger"]},"lv":{}}],"tip":[{"blue":["jung"],"green":["Jung"]},{"blue":["jung"],"purple":["alt"]}],"important":[{},{"green":["neu"],"blue":["jung"]},{"blue":["jung"],"green":["neu"]}]}}
